simple.meaning: חֲמָתִי (Chămâthîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Chamathite or native of Chamath.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חֲמָתִי (H2577) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 10:18, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲמָתִי (H2577) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חֲמָתִי (H2577) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חֲמָתִי (Chămâthîy) / H2577 is traced through Genesis 10:18, 1 Chronicles 1:16 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
